anyOf.description: Report-selected identity. Compare before creating a plan; mismatch refuses target_changed. Generation is an inode identity, not a content modification counter.

paramsSchema.description: Queue a sealed plan; no files are deleted. NAS paths and identities are private.

preview.rootfs_plan.summary: Preview submission only: Queue a system cleanup plan and return its job ID immediately

to.description: Absolute NAS path on a mounted data volume.

mode.description: Existing system cleanup mode. Deep can affect caches and user preferences.

preview.cleanup_apply.summary: Preview submission only: Apply the exact reviewed plan asynchronously; items move into their shared folders' Recycle Bins, restored or emptied in DSM

plan_id.description: Exact sealed plan ID from the completed planning job. Stale or changed plans are refused.

confirm_move.description: Explicit confirmation that the plan's items move into their shared folders' Recycle Bins; does not replace executor approval or --yes.

confirm_delete.description: Explicit confirmation that the plan's items in no shared folder (plan shares marked delete) are removed for good, with no Recycle Bin; required when the plan's deletes is not 0.

preview.rootfs_apply.summary: Preview submission only: Apply the exact reviewed system partition plan asynchronously; moves and permanent deletion, no automatic restore

plan_id.description: Exact sealed plan ID from the completed planning job. Stale or changed plans are refused.

confirm_no_restore.description: Explicit confirmation of irreversible effects; does not replace executor approval or --yes.

preview.cache_clear.summary: Preview submission only: Delete saved report cache for a volume; user files are kept

volume.description: Mounted NAS Btrfs volume root. Use volumes list to discover it.

preview.setup_cleanup.summary: Preview submission only: Set the existing mutation kill switch; never authorize the executor

mutations_disabled.description: True blocks mutations; false removes the kill switch without granting executor authority.
